verses.text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

segments.text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

segments.text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock

verses.text: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

segments.text: For thou hast been a shelter for me,
a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

segments.text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

segments.text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given
the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

segments.text: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life:

notes: 61.6 Thou…: Heb. Thou shalt add days to the days of the king
61.6 as…: Heb. as generation and generation

verses.text: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

segments.text: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth,

verses.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

segments.text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Neginah, A Psalm of David.
